notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

After Cloud Climber came out lots of people wanted more, so I've been working hard to put together a fan pack for anyone who has enjoyed the game, or wants to support my future projects!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1533460

notes.title: Want More From Two Star Games?
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h2]

For those of you who've enjoyed Cloud Climber and want more, I've decided to make this post to shamelessly plug some other stuff you might be interested in :)

As you know, I'm a game developer, so here are my other games that I think you'd enjoy!

[h2]My Beautiful Paper Smile[/h2]

[previewyoutube=eIzDbQKxVN8;full][/previewyoutube]
This is my main project, that I've been working on for the past three years.  It's not as relaxing as Cloud Climber, but will definitely appeal to anyone that's into gritty adventure games, story-driven games with horror aspects.  It's about a a world where children are raised in large facilities, and taught to smile at all times.  If the kids show any emotion other than happiness they are deemed imperfect, and are heavily punished.  You play as a child who decides to escape, and find the reason behind this twisted operation.  You can play the first three out of four chapters right now, or add it to your Wishlist to be notified when the full game releases later this summer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036700/My_Beautiful_Paper_Smile/


[h2]My Friend is a Raven[/h2]

[previewyoutube=vPP70YMI0xs;full][/previewyoutube]
My Friend is a Raven is another short, free game I made!  It's a story driven point and click game, about a plague doctor, and a talking raven.  The birds spread the plague all across the world, and your choices in the game will dictate how the story ends.  Each ending reveals more about the world, and the dark history between the doctor and the raven.  You can play it for free right here on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1215090/My_Friend_is_a_Raven/


[h1][b]I'm also on Twitter![/b][/h1]

[b]If you want to keep up to date with all my future projects, be sure to click the handle below to follow me over there.  I'm sure you won't be disappointed ;)[/b]

notes.title: Cloud Climber has Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h2]

Gavin here from Two Star Games, and I'm proud to share [b]Cloud Climber[/b] with everyone here on Steam.  Cloud Climber is a short story based game that I made in one week for the 2020 Epic MegaJam, which took place in December.  Creating this game was honestly a really nice way to end a crummy year.

[previewyoutube=vmso5EIuo7E;full][/previewyoutube]

The theme of the game jam was "It's been a long time, but we're not done yet", and I decided to go the "we've been building towers for a long time" route.  The story centers around the concept that it has stopped raining, and as Earths water evaporated people began building towers with the intention of reaching the clouds to get get water out of them.  They've been building for  long time, but they haven't reached the clouds yet!

I'm really proud of this concept, and how it has turned out.  Considering it's a game about the end of humanity, it somehow became a really relaxing experience (to play, not to make lol).  The sun casts aa warm light through the fog, as a soft wind howls, and blows dust through the towers.  It's unlike any other game I've created and it was a blast to try out something new.

I know it's pretty short, but since the reception has been so positive, I decided that the general Steam audience might enjoy it.  I really hope you have fun with it!

-Gavin Eisenbeisz, Two Star Games
